name: 20100910.deer.rut.wav
description: Headphones recommended: the summer-dry marshes of Donana (S Spain) resonate with the unmistakable roaring of male Red-deer summoning their females during rut. Some bird chirps and crickets can also be heard. For the critical listener: the sound of friction in background is not whitenoise, it was produced by the deers walking across dry vegetation. Sennheiser MKH30 + MKH60 into Shure FP24 preamp, Olympus LS10 recorder. Decoded to mid-side stereo with free Voxengo VST plugin. This is a 24-bit sample.

name: Red Deer Stag Bellowing
description:
Red deer stag bellowing recorded at Bedfords Park, Essex, UK.  The stag was with a group of hinds during the rutting season.  These were not wild animals but kept in a large pen within the park.  This was a medieval hunting forest and red deer have been kept here in modern times since the 1930s.

In addition to the stag, a number of other sounds can be heard, including the stag breathing out heavily, the deer feeding on the grass and a number of birds, particularly jackdaws.  There is some background noise and unwanted sounds, but no attempt has been made to reduce that as this would have had an impact on the sound of the stag (see additional comment below).

Recorded with a Sennheiser K6/ME66 microphone with Radius windshield attached to a Zoom F6.  As a point of interest, I also tried making some recordings with a parabolic mic (not included here) in order to get a greater focus on the stag but the quality of the sound was awful as it took away much of the deep quality of the stag's call.

name: 20100908.22h33m.mp3
description: Mono recording of night ambiance at Donana National Park (S Spain), with male Red Deer roaring and crickets in background. A Tawny Owl can also be heard just at the beginning. Recorded remotely using a permanent, simple setup installed by ICTS (Reserva Biologica de Donana, CSIC, Spain: http://icts.ebd.csic.es/) operated with solar energy. Sample kindly provided by ICTS, Reserva Biologica de Donana, CSIC, Spain

name: 20100912.22h.00m.dark.is.the.night.wav

name: 20100912.21h.20m.wildboar.wav
description: Quite scary if you are in a wild area in the middle of the night, and you don't know WHAT makes these noises. Wild pigs rooting around and squealing, while male Red-deers roar and crickets sing. Recorded remotely using a permanent setup installed by ICTS (Reserva Biológica de Doñana, CSIC, Spain: http:// icts.ebd.csic.es/) at Las Pajareras. Mic was a Sennheiser ME62 on a K6 system.

name: Red Deer bugling during rutting season, northern Scotland.
description: Recorded October 1, 2024 at 2000 hrs from window of Rhiconich Hotel, Rhiconich, Scotland. Latitude: 58° 31’ 28” N Longitude 4° 13’ 26” W Red Deer stags bugling during rutting season. Closest stag approximately 20 meters from recording location along Rhiconich River above Loch Inchard. Distant stags were approximately 1-2 kilometres away. Recorded on Sony M10 with LOM MicroUsi pair, bubblebees, AB stereo, 50 cm separation, 24bit/96K. The sound of the Rhiconich River was reduced using spectral de-noise in Izotope RX10. Cuts and fades in/out in Izotope RX10. Attribution: Robert Crosley and freesound.org. Thankyou!
